items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 11 July 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the northwest of the British Isles.


##Wind##

Northerly 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the west, but variable 2 to 4 in the east, becoming east or northeast 4 or 5 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming mainly slight later today, and occasionally moderate in the far southwest of the area tonight & tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps occasionally moderate near some coasts.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast mainly 4 or 5, perhaps occasionally 6 in places, decreasing later in the period to 3 or 4 occasionally 5.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
